objective: Build a same-protocol residential SOTA evidence package by closing the ordered room -> support -> owner/wall/junction -> opening-host -> canonical CAD chain, then run matched external comparisons and frozen tests. Do not touch chips/FloorSet.

training_ladder.contract_smoke: One real batch with finite gradients, disabled-branch equality, typed outputs, and downstream consumer.
training_ladder.scale_screen: Full train split with 384 calibration and 107 offset-384 holdout cases; five seeds.
training_ladder.acceptance: Full val491 plus complete canonical-plan structural evaluation; test only after freeze.

dense_query_blend_room_identity.decision: hold as a diagnostic room-only readout.

selective_support_deletion.decision: hold; room-only gains do not survive canonical wall composition.

opening_interval_integration.decision: active promotion; full-val paired result pending.

negative_results.reason: Room-only, canonical, oracle, predicted, generation, and editing rows must stay separate.

negative_results.lesson: A global scale does not replace a typed spatial consumer.

negative_results.arm: Hard owner attention or dense owner supervision
negative_results.lesson: Hard routing reduces Room IoU or memorizes assignments.
The 128/64 connector gain did not scale; cache frozen candidates.

negative_results.arm: Post-hoc room count merge or component relabel
negative_results.lesson: Count can improve while identity collapses; learn support and identity together.
The existence head saturated and learned arbitration did not beat query-only.
Count gains traded away Room/support and holdout quality.

negative_results.arm: Selective support deletion as complete CAD
negative_results.lesson: A head must be consumed during owner/wall learning, not only after canonical composition.
Walls need room boundaries; openings need named host walls.

same_protocol_sota_blockers.room_identity: Predicted-control Room IoU is around 0.33; instance count and holdout stability remain weak.
same_protocol_sota_blockers.support_to_structure: Support gains must be consumed before owner/wall construction; post-hoc cleanup regresses wall F1.
same_protocol_sota_blockers.walls_and_junctions: Canonical wall F1 is around 0.47; junction state is not yet a promoted typed vector.
same_protocol_sota_blockers.opening_hosts: Bridge opening F1 is around 0.10; the interval decoder reaches around 0.28 on cal64 but needs full-val and seed validation.
same_protocol_sota_blockers.furniture: Vector furniture remains support evidence, not semantic SOTA.
same_protocol_sota_blockers.external_execution: HouseMind-E complete inference remains unavailable; Raster2Seq is a matched reconstruction baseline.
same_protocol_sota_blockers.test_discipline: RPLAN and CubiCasa test stay closed until validation, thresholds, and baseline wrappers freeze.

typed_contracts.room: class logits + instance masks + support probability
typed_contracts.owner: owner raster + room-id map + shared boundary edges
typed_contracts.opening: host wall id + interval + family/type + score
typed_contracts.validation: typed violation codes + bounded repair operations

rules: Every optional stage exposes a typed object and one verified downstream consumer.
Stage order is executable and tested; no module may silently read a later-stage tensor.
Disabled branches reproduce the parent checkpoint.
A metric branch is rejected if it works only in a room-only evaluator.
Every promotion records parameters, updates, NFE, latency, seed, split, and artifact hashes.

dynamic_control_audit.finding: MixtureTopKAttention and SparseControlAttention exist, but the promoted room-query decoder used static query embeddings and ordinary masked cross-attention; room and opening training used fixed loss weights.
implemented_controls: opt-in AdaptiveQueryReferenceRefiner with image-global-conditioned reference points and grid_sample features
opt-in GradientNormBalancer for room-mask, partition, dense-identity, and teacher terms
disabled branches reproduce the parent model exactly

tasks.title: Canonical opening interval integration
actions: Finish full val491 with the existing opening interval checkpoint at frozen threshold 0.3.
Run a case-paired comparison against the identical blend50 plan without the detector.
Train five seed-matched interval heads and evaluate 384 calibration plus 107 offset-384 holdout.
Connect the accepted detector to CadStageRuntime as an opening-only replacement.

gate.primary: Opening F1 improves with a paired 95% interval excluding zero.
gate.non_regression: Room, wall, Node, Edge, and GED do not regress beyond paired noise.
gate.scope: Opening integration only; no complete-CAD SOTA claim.

tasks.failure_response: If full validation fails, return to joint selected-wall host supervision.

tasks.title: Adaptive room query and loss-weight attribution
actions: Run a matched 256/64 screen with four arms: static, adaptive reference queries, dynamic loss weights, and both.
Verify adaptive references differ across distinct images and that the zero-initialized branch exactly matches the parent checkpoint.
Require Room IoU, instance F1, and count MAE to improve jointly on calibration and offset-128 holdout before scaling.
Promote the winning adaptive arm to 1024/256 two-seed, then full validation.
Record reference displacement, router/gradient-scale diagnostics, parameters, latency, and disabled-branch equality.

gate.mechanism: Adaptive references are sample-dependent and nonzero after training; loss scales stay in the declared bounded range.
gate.quality: The winning arm passes the same room and structural non-regression gates as the room-query candidate.
gate.attribution: Single-mechanism arms are reported; do not claim an aggregate gain without ablation.

tasks.failure_response: Keep the disabled static path; inspect reference collapse or gradient-scale saturation before adding capacity.

tasks.title: Support-owner-wall and junction closure
actions: Consume support probability during owner-cell and wall-candidate learning.
Make junction incidence a typed state consumed by endpoint snapping and opening hosts.
Supervise wall candidates against canonical vector targets and selected room boundaries.
Reject wall gains that increase opening or graph regression.

gate.quality: Wall F1 improves over 0.47 with no Room IoU or count regression.
gate.order: Room/support precede owner/wall/junction states in tests and runtime.

tasks.failure_response: Return to the failing stage contract before adding capacity.

tasks.title: Matched same-protocol external evidence
actions: Freeze executable Raster2Seq, CE2EPlan, TLC-Plan, and any recovered HouseMind row.
Use identical cases, preprocessing, evaluator, post-processing, and compute accounting.
Report paired bootstrap and Wilcoxon effect sizes with parameters, exposure, latency, and NFE.
Keep generation, reconstruction, predicted-control, oracle-control, and free-text rows separate.

gate.primary: One protocol-primary metric improves with a paired interval excluding zero and no structural regression.

tasks.title: RPLAN five-seed validation and frozen test
actions: Run the final architecture on five seeds and full RPLAN validation.
Freeze code, checkpoints, thresholds, baselines, and statistics.
Open test exactly once.
Keep complete-CAD and generation tables separate.

gate.stability: All five seeds preserve quality and structural gates.
gate.reproducibility: Every number maps to a frozen artifact and command.

tasks.failure_response: Keep test closed and return to validation.

tasks.title: Predicted-control and free-text editing
actions: Predict edit regions and typed actions without oracle controls.
Keep outside freezing as an independently audited certificate.
Add text parsing and abstention only after predicted controls stabilize.
Compare only with fully executable same-protocol baselines.
tasks.failure_response: Disable free-text promotion if predicted controls are unstable.

tasks.title: CVPR evidence freeze
actions: Run non-chips tests, Ruff, 600-line checks, JSON validation, manifest and SHA-256 verification.
Package every reported number with its generator and source artifact.
Freeze protocol coverage, environment lockfile, and deterministic archive.
Audit claim boundaries and exclude chips/FloorSet artifacts.
tasks.failure_response: Remove the unsupported claim or repair the evidence chain.
